annotations.text:
Studio direction

A softly lit studio ground, white surfaces, ink controls with a bottom edge you can press into. Every goal is a stone: a dimensional sphere coloured by its domain (coral health, teal money, violet craft, amber mind); the coach is a pearl. Stones get polished as goals are kept.

One typeface (Outfit). Springy motion: stones float and catch the light, rings draw, buttons pop in. Night studio only for the seal ritual.

Landscape and Poster are archived in design/archive with their own links.
Photographs stand in for generated scenes (Unsplash licence: Tyler Criso, Kevin Bessat), shown as prints with a slight tilt.

Prototype: Today, The Interview and Seal the day are live (press ▷ on the artboard).

Interview: every answer is a tap. Pick the parts of life that are pulling at you, then each one gets two or three multiple‑choice questions and becomes a goal stone in the tray. “Something else…” opens a field only when no answer fits. Drop or add goals at the end.

Today: tap a stone to seat it; drag a stone upward and let go to park it as “not today”; the wind‑down routine sinks one step per tap. Tap a goal at the top and its stone flies into the Goal screen; Back flies it home.

Tabs: Envision (tap the print for the next scene, tap a tone to re‑render it, Wallpaper to save) and Coach (tap a reply chip and the coach answers; the brief folds away). The target tab opens the Now goal.

The + button opens the New move sheet: pick a goal stone, a suggestion or your own words, how long it takes, and it lands at the top of Later today. Parking a stone shows an Undo toast; Consistency bumps as it changes.

Seal: pick a word, then press and hold the bar for about two seconds. Let go early and it drains back.
